chunks: Muhammad ibn 'Ali ibn Mahbub, from al-'Ubaydi, from Sulayman ibn Ja'far, said:
The Faqih, peace be upon him, said: The end of the time of the 'asr prayer is six and a half feet.

key_terms.آخِرُ: the final limit or end point
key_terms.أَقْدَامٍ: feet; a classical unit used here for determining prayer time
key_terms.الْفَقِيهُ: the Imam referred to as the jurist
key_terms.وَقْتِ: the prescribed time of an act of worship

ai.seo_question: What is the end time of the 'asr prayer according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning the latest time for the 'asr prayer. It defines the end of its time using the classical measure of shadow-length, indicating a precise framework for observing salat times in fiqh.
